column1: # Stage S10 H3c, workspace crate: the engine diagnostics benches (the building viewer, the world
# line-of-sight bench, the equipment data viewer and the ballistics agreement bench, with the
# interior lanes and scene geometry they share) become crates/frontend/workspaces/debug_benches.
# The folder becomes the crate's `src`, its module tree `lib.rs`, and its README the source tree
# README; the feature docs move to their mirror under
# documentation/crates/frontend/workspaces/debug_benches. The prefix is one `crate::` row scoped
# to the moved folder and one `debug_benches::` row scoped to the app's source.
